_written: 2026-10-10, BEFORE computing any return on the FTMO-mapped universe. Generation 22 (prop-firm track).

firm_rules (UNCERTAIN: ftmo.com search e.account: FTMO 2-Step, Swing type (overnight/weekend holding allowed), 100k USD
firm_rules (UNCERTAIN: ftmo.com search e.max_daily_loss: 5% of initial balance; equity (open+closed) must stay above [balance at midnight CE(S)T] - 5% of initial
firm_rules (UNCERTAIN: ftmo.com search e.max_loss: 10% of initial balance, static, equity incl. open positions
firm_rules (UNCERTAIN: ftmo.com search e.payout_assumed: funded: 80% profit split (up to 90% advertised), payout possible monthly; fee (~540 EUR for 100k) refunded with first payout - fee and split are UNCERTAIN

universe_map (FTMO CFD -> pysystemtrade.rule: use each listed name if present in futures_panel.universe(); price proxy = futures return (CFD on the same underlying)

cfd_cost_model (ASSUMPTION).base: 2x the futures spread+commission cost per unit turnover + 2.5% p.a. financing markup on gross notional held
cfd_cost_model (ASSUMPTION).note: futures returns are excess returns, so CFD swap is modelled as the broker markup only; FTMO swap tables could not be read

strategies.P22a_TREND: mean of F0 (CT1 transfer), F1 TSMOM(63,126,252), F2 EWMAC(4 speeds) signals; panel engine (sigma EWMA35, equal risk, 2-day lag); buffer b = 0.05; gross notional capped at 8x
strategies.P22b_TREND_CARRY: F9 construction (equal risk TREND and CARRY sleeves) on the same universe, buffer 0.05, cap 8x

contamination: All periods were viewed for the full-universe trend/carry in V6 gen13. The new information here is (1) the restricted FTMO universe without bonds/STIR, (2) CFD costs, (3) the prop-rule overlay. Post-2014 is labelled contaminated.

prop_simulation.returns: strategy daily net return rescaled to an annual vol target v in {0.06, 0.08, 0.10, 0.12, 0.15} (linear scaling of the 10%-vol book)
prop_simulation.starts: historical start every 10 trading days; each start runs Phase 1 (+10%) then a fresh Phase 2 (+5%) then 12 months funded; evaluation unresolved after 36 months counts as not passed

daily_loss_proxy.optimistic: balance = previous close equity; intraday loss = 1.5 x close-to-close loss
daily_loss_proxy.conservative: balance = highest close equity of the last 10 days (floating losses on held positions accrue against the midnight balance); same 1.5 x intraday factor

prop_simulation.funded: monthly: withdraw 80% of profit above initial if positive and reset to initial; fail on the same loss rules
prop_simulation.choice_of_v: chosen ONLY from starts in 1990-2013 by maximising P(pass both phases within 24 months) subject to P(fail) <= 35%; post-2014 starts reported as contaminated-secondary
prop_simulation.bootstrap: stationary block bootstrap (20-day blocks) of 2010-2024 daily returns (the decayed regime), 3000 paths, as the forward-looking estimate

gates.conventional: VALIDATION net Sharpe >= 0.4 at base CFD costs AND DISCOVERY >= 0.6 AND VALIDATION > 0 at stress costs
gates.prop: at the chosen v, conservative proxy, starts 1990-2013: P(pass both phases within 24 months) >= 0.50 AND P(fail before passing) <= 0.35
